w10_T4_001831: A granola bar weighs 71 grams, and the bars are sold in packs of 5, with 8 packs to a box. The cardboard of each box adds another 77 grams to it. A shop ordered 6 of those boxes, and the courier added a 22-gram address label to the shipment. The drive from the warehouse to the shop takes 40 minutes. The warehouse records weights in grams rather than kilograms, and one thousand grams make a kilogram. How many grams does the whole shipment weigh?
w10_T4_001833: Ola started the term with 151 stickers in her album, which has 20 pages. She gave 7 stickers to her cousin, 31 stickers to her best friend, and 101 stickers to the class swap box. Her classmate Pia has half as many stickers as Ola has left, so Ola still has the bigger collection. Pia then lost 4 stickers on the bus. How many stickers does Pia have now?
w10_T4_001838: On a typical weekday Quentin has 59 minutes of free time after school. This term his bus route changed, giving him 15 minutes more each weekday, and a cancelled club gave him another 51 minutes. He then took on a 105-minute tutoring session each weekday, and he also spends 5 minutes every weekday feeding the cat, both of which come out of his free time. He plans his free time in minutes rather than hours, since sixty minutes make one hour, and he thinks a dozen minutes is barely enough for anything. There are 5 weekdays in a school week. How many minutes of free time does Quentin have in a school week?
w10_T4_001839: A poultry farm keeps 20 hens in each coop, with 7 coops in every barn and 9 barns on the farm. Before the winter the farmer sold 784 hens to a neighbour. She then moved all the remaining hens equally into 4 fenced fields. Over the following month the north field received 41 more hens from a rescue centre and then 26 more from a local school, which had kept them for a dozen years as pets. How many hens are in the north field now?
w10_T4_001841: A garden hose was delivering 153 litres of water an hour, but a leak in the fitting lost 23 litres an hour and a kink in the hose lost 1 litre an hour more. Rita left the hose running at that reduced rate for 8 hours a day. Each day's water was shared equally among her 6 vegetable beds through a splitter valve. The tomato bed, which sits at the end of the garden behind a dozen sunflowers, received its share on each of 4 days. How many litres of water did the tomato bed receive over those 4 days?
w10_T4_001862: Sam tracks his walking in minutes rather than hours, reminding himself that sixty minutes make one hour. In the morning he walked 38 minutes to the office, then 14 minutes to the bakery and back for lunch, and 5 minutes over to the print shop. In the afternoon he spent 70 minutes walking around a building site with a client and then walked 35 minutes home. In the evening he took the dog out for a 25-minute walk. How many minutes did Sam walk in total that day?
w10_T4_001866: Tess mailed a parcel weighing 95 grams. Her brother Uli's parcel weighed twice as much as Tess's, so Uli's was the heavier one, and after he added 14 grams of tape it was heavier still. Uli then made up 8 parcels of exactly that same weight for his customers, put them all in one crate, and stuck a 5-gram label on the crate. At the depot, items weighing 1169 grams in total were removed from the crate because they were not allowed in the post, and everything that remained, label included, was repacked equally into 3 smaller boxes. Uli records weights in grams rather than kilograms, though he knows one thousand grams make a kilogram. How many grams did one of those 3 boxes hold?
w10_T4_001873: Vera planted 40 dahlia tubers in the spring, but only half of them survived a late frost. Each surviving tuber sent up 3 stems, and every stem produced 9 flowers over the summer. Vera cut all the flowers and tied them into bunches of 6 to sell at the market. How many bunches did she make?
w10_T4_001875: A taxi ride to the airport has a base fare of 112 cents, plus a 5-cent booking charge and a 34-cent airport charge. The driver's app then takes 2 cents off for a loyalty reward, and Wanda adds a 42-cent tip on every ride. Wanda took 4 such rides this month, all with the same charges and the same tip. She keeps her expenses in cents rather than dollars, remembering that one hundred cents make a dollar. How many cents did Wanda spend on those 4 rides?
w10_T4_001877: Willa's bakery makes 3 batches of cookies every working day, with 177 cookies in each batch, and then adds a single extra batch of 44 cookies for the staff room. That daily total is more cookies than Xena's bakery across the street manages in a whole week. Willa's bakery works 3 days each week and keeps to the same daily output every working day. The current contract with the supermarket runs for 8 weeks. How many cookies will Willa's bakery make over the contract?
w10_T4_001881: In the morning the tour company checked its coaches: each coach has 82 seats, but 8 seats on every coach were taken out for luggage racks, and 7 coaches were assigned to the festival. A minibus fleet with 77 seats in total was added to the same booking. The festival site is 120 kilometres from the city. In the afternoon 530 of the seats were sold to fans. In the evening the company sold every remaining seat at a last-minute price of 4 dollars each. How many dollars did the company take from the last-minute sales?
w10_T4_001887: Yuki had 235 cents in her pocket, spent 194 cents on a bus ticket, and then found 20 cents on the floor of the bus. Her brother Zane had 4 times as many cents as Yuki had after that, so Zane was the richer of the two. Zane then earned 73 cents returning bottles and 63 cents sweeping a neighbour's path, which took him about a dozen minutes. Zane counts his money in cents rather than dollars, knowing that one hundred cents make a dollar. How many cents does Zane have now?
w10_T4_001888: In the morning a crate of 132 oranges was divided equally into 3 baskets, one for each of the market's 3 fruit stalls, and Ben's stall received its basket. Later in the morning Ben added 33 oranges from his own garden to his stall. In the afternoon Ben sold 76 oranges to customers. In the evening a farmer dropped off 73 more oranges at Ben's stall. How many oranges does Ben's stall have now?
w10_T4_001905: Cal picked 229 apples from the single tree in his back garden. Dana's orchard has 8 rows of 8 trees, and every one of her trees gave exactly as many apples as Cal's tree did, so Dana's harvest was far bigger than Cal's. Dana also picked 44 apples from a lone tree by the gate. Her farm covers 30 hectares. She sold every apple at 9 cents each and then paid 53180 cents to the pickers, working entirely in cents rather than dollars, since one hundred cents make a dollar. How many cents did Dana have left after paying the pickers?
w10_T4_001910: Eve had 111 dollars in the first jar on her shelf and spent 96 dollars from it on a train ticket. She then discovered that she had 9 jars in all on that shelf, each holding exactly the same amount as the first jar now held, and she poured all of them together into one purse. From that purse she paid 3 dollars for a coffee, received 13 dollars from a friend repaying a loan, paid 92 dollars towards her rent, and spent 41 dollars on groceries. Eve keeps her accounts in dollars rather than cents, since counting one hundred cents to the dollar is tedious. How many dollars are in the purse now?
w10_T4_001911: A ferry left the island with 94 passengers on board. At the first stop 19 passengers got on and 60 got off. At the second stop 55 passengers got on and 58 got off. The ferry is 45 metres long. How many passengers are on the ferry after the second stop?
w10_T4_001912: Fay ordered 5 boxes of candles with 66 candles in each box and split them equally among her 3 shops. Each shop sold all of its candles at 6 dollars apiece, and the money from the High Street shop was divided equally among its 4 partners. The candles are 20 centimetres tall. Gil, one of those partners, then received a 79-dollar bonus on top of his share. How many dollars did Gil receive in total?
w10_T4_001918: Hal had 219 old coins in his collection. He gave 67 coins to a museum and sold 132 coins to a dealer. His friend Ivy has twice as many coins as Hal has left, so Ivy now has the larger collection. Ivy then traded away 22 coins at a fair. How many coins does Ivy have now?
w10_T4_001920: A warehouse received 8 pallets, each stacked with 128 boxes of tiles, and put them all in the loading bay. Over the week the bay shipped out 729 boxes to a builder, 167 boxes to a hardware store, and 118 boxes to a hotel. The boxes still in the bay were then spread equally across 5 shelves. On Friday a delivery of 33 boxes was placed on the top shelf. How many boxes are on the top shelf now?
w10_T4_001926: Jack had 77 dollars in his wallet. His sister Kira had triple the amount Jack had, so Kira was the better off of the two. Kira spent 70 dollars on a concert ticket and 128 dollars on a coat. She then earned 9 dollars returning bottles and spent 34 dollars on a birthday present. Kira keeps track in dollars rather than cents, knowing that one hundred cents make a dollar. How many dollars does Kira have now?
w10_T4_001929: In the morning Leo packed 14 jars of honey into a crate and then squeezed 16 more jars in, and he filled 5 crates in exactly the same way for his market stall, which was more honey than his rival Mo brought that day. In the afternoon Leo's cousin dropped off 35 more jars at the stall. In the evening Leo sold every jar he had at 5 dollars each. How many dollars did Leo take in the evening?
w10_T4_001938: In the morning the school canteen received 7 boxes of doughnuts with 14 doughnuts in each box, and then a second supplier dropped off 67 more doughnuts. In the afternoon a parent baked 35 doughnuts for the bake sale and added them to the pile. In the evening 114 doughnuts were sold at the school concert. How many doughnuts were left after the concert?
w10_T4_001939: A bus left the depot with 71 passengers on board. At the first stop 14 passengers got off, at the second stop 16 got off, and at the third stop 36 got off. The bus has 3 doors. At the fourth stop 20 passengers got on, at the fifth stop 44 got on, and at the sixth stop 4 got off. How many passengers are on the bus now?
w10_T4_001942: Nia had 203 dollars in her savings account. She deposited 57 dollars from babysitting and 25 dollars from a birthday card. She then withdrew 266 dollars to buy a bicycle, which she uses to cycle a dozen kilometres to college each day. Her aunt later transferred 27 dollars into the account. How many dollars are in Nia's account now?
w10_T4_001944: Every day at the pool, which has a dozen lanes, Otto swims 178 metres as a warm-up, then adds 75 metres of backstroke and another 75 metres of front crawl to his session, which is farther than his friend Pam swims in a day. He keeps to exactly that daily session on each of the 7 days of the week. This week, on Sunday, he also swam an extra 19 metres to finish a race with Pam. How many metres did Otto swim this week?
